texture.e: 拉丁语 textura, 源自 texere, textum, to weave: 参见 法语 texture. 见 Text.
k: 面孔的一部分(如眼、口等)，特征

thalamus.e: 拉丁语 thalamus chamber, 希腊语 qa`lamos.

thallium.e: 新拉丁语, 源自 希腊语 green line in its spectrum.

than.e: 中古英语 than, thon, then, thanne, thonne, thenne, than, then, 古英语 ðanne, ðonne, ðaenne; 同源于 荷兰语 dan, 古高地德语 danne, 德语 dann then, denn than, for, 哥特语 þan then, and to 英语 the, there, that. 见 That, and 参见 Then.

k: 行星，命运星辰，杰出的人

thank.e: 古英语 þanc, þonc, thanks, favor, thought; 同源于 OS. thank favor, pleasure, thanks, 荷兰语 & 德语 dank thanks, 冰岛语 þökk, 丹麦语 tak, 瑞典语 tack, 哥特语 þagks thanks; -- originally, a thought, a thinking. 见 Think.

s: 感谢的，感激的，令人快意的
忘恩负义的，使人不愉快的，徒劳的

that.e: 古英语 ðaet, neuter nom. & acc. sing. of the article (originally a demonstrative pronoun). The nom. masc. sē, and the nom. fem. seó are from a different root. 古英语 ðaet is 同源于 荷兰语 dat, 德语 das, 古高地德语 daz, 瑞典语 & 丹麦语 det, 冰岛语 þat (masc. sā, fem. sō), 哥特语 þata (masc. sa, fem. sō), 希腊语 tat (for tad, masc. sas, fem. sā); 参见 拉丁语

thatch.e: 中古英语 thak, 古英语 þæc a roof; 同源于 þeccean to cover, 荷兰语 dak a roof, dekken to cover, 德语 dach a roof, decken 8cover, 冰岛语 þak a roof, 瑞典语 tak, 丹麦语 tag, Lith. stōgas, 爱尔兰语 teagh a house, Gael. teach, tigh, 威尔士语 ty, 拉丁语 tegere to cover, toga a toga, 希腊语 sthag. 参见 Deck, Integument, Tile, Toga.

thaw.e: 古英语 þāwian, þāwan; 同源于 荷兰语 dovijen, 德语 tauen, thauen (参见 also verdauen to digest, 古高地德语 douwen, firdouwen), 冰岛语 þeyja, 瑞典语 töa, 丹麦语 töe, and perhaps to 希腊语 th`kein to melt.
